meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 收到 triage 指令后,Claude 会读取当前仓库所有仍开放的 issue 和 PR,逐一交给后台子代理分析、分类,并把每项带证据链接的报告写入 /tmp 的时间戳目录。它只读取,不在 GitHub 上评论、关闭、合并或加标签,只产出报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”“triage issues”“github triage”等触发词时,技能启动,开始分析本仓库。

say.text: triage 本仓库所有开放的 issue 和 PR
say.note: 启动全量后台分析并写出报告

say.text: 运行 github triage,给每个条目写一份带证据的报告
say.note: 报告写入 /tmp 下新建立的时间戳目录

say.text: triage PRs,重点关注修复类 PR 的质量
say.note: 对 PR 只读审查,不会改动任何内容

howto.what_en: On triage, Claude scans all open issues/PRs, spawns one background subagent per item, classifies each, and writes evidence-backed reports to a new /tmp timestamp directory. Report-only: it never comments, closes, merges, or labels on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “triage”, “triage issues”, “github triage”, or similar trigger phrases.

say_en.text: Triage all open issues and PRs in this repo.
say_en.note: Runs background analysis and writes reports.

say_en.text: Run github triage and write an evidence-backed report per item.
say_en.note: Reports go to a new timestamped folder under /tmp.

say_en.text: Triage PRs, focusing on the quality of bugfix PRs.
say_en.note: Read-only review; nothing on GitHub is changed.
